name_en: Kozuyu — a scallop-broth vegetable soup served in shallow lacquer dishes
summary_ja: 貝柱のだしできくらげや里芋、わらびなど7つか9つの具を煮て、浅い会津塗の「手塩皿」に盛る会津の冠婚葬祭料理。奇数の具材が縁起が良いとされ、婚礼の宴では何杯おかわりしてもよいとされていたという。
summary_en: Wood ear mushroom, taro, fiddlehead fern, and other ingredients — seven or nine kinds — simmer in a scallop broth and are ladled into shallow lacquered Aizu-nuri dishes. An odd number of ingredients is said to be lucky, and at wedding banquets, guests could refill the dish as many times as they liked.
source_title: こづゆ 福島県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Zakuzaku — root vegetables and chicken cut into cubes and simmered in dashi
summary_ja: 里芋やにんじん、ごぼう、こんにゃくなどをざくざくと角切りにし、煮干しなどのだしで煮て醤油で調える二本松の料理。江戸期の文献に「菜を細かく切ったもの」と記され、冠婚葬祭や祭りに供されてきたという。
summary_en: Taro, carrot, burdock, and konnyaku are cut into rough cubes — zaku-zaku — and simmered in a dashi of dried sardine or the like, seasoned with soy sauce — a dish of Nihonmatsu. An Edo-period text describes it as vegetables cut small, and it is said to have long been served at weddings, funerals, and festivals.
source_title: ざくざく 福島県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Tsuyu nishime — dried herring and straw-wrapped tofu simmered in a seasoned broth
summary_ja: わらで包んで保存性を高めた「つと豆腐」と身欠きにしん、里芋、昆布をだしで煮て醤油と砂糖で仕立てる南会津の料理。冠婚葬祭や祭りの酒の肴として供され、今もイベントで振る舞われているという。
summary_en: Tsuto-dofu, tofu wrapped in straw for better keeping, simmers in dashi with dried herring, taro, and kelp, seasoned with soy sauce and sugar — a dish of Minamiaizu. It is served at weddings, funerals, and festivals as an accompaniment to sake, and is said to still be served at local events.
source_title: つゆ煮しめ 福島県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Koikoku — carp and tofu simmered into a hearty miso soup
summary_ja: 切り身の鯉をきくらげや豆腐、ねぎと煮込み、味噌で味を調える郡山の汁物。だしに鯉のうまみがしっかり染み込む一杯で、出産後の母乳がよく出るようにと願いを込めた栄養食として作られることが多いという。
summary_en: Carp fillets are simmered with wood ear mushroom, tofu, and scallion and finished with miso — a hearty soup of Koriyama. The broth takes on a deep carp flavor, and it is said to be made especially for new mothers, in the hope it helps milk come in after childbirth.
source_title: 鯉こく 福島県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Donko jiru — a miso soup built on a hardy coastal fish and its liver
summary_ja: 北海道から福島県浜通りの沿岸にすむ「どんこ」（正式名エゾイソアイナメ）を大根や白菜、人参と煮て味噌で仕立てる相馬の汁物。鮮度が落ちやすく刺身は現地でしか食べられないが、肝の入る秋冬が旬とされる。
summary_en: Donko, formally called ezo-isoainame, a fish found from Hokkaido down to Fukushima's Hamadori coast, is simmered with daikon, napa cabbage, and carrot and finished with miso — a soup of Soma. It spoils fast enough that only locals eat it raw, and autumn through winter, when the liver fills out, is said to be its season.
source_title: どんこ汁 福島県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
